story_type: first autonomous aerial refueling by a drone
hook: Nobody was flying this jet as it plugged into a tanker midair.
narration: Nobody was flying this jet as it plugged into a tanker in midair.
The Navy's X-47B test drone did it on April twenty-second, 2015, near Patuxent River, Maryland.
It was the first time an unmanned aircraft had ever refueled itself in flight.
The tanker trails a hose with a basket on the end. The receiving aircraft has to fly its probe into that basket while both planes hold the same speed.
[short pause] Here the computer did all of it, holding the jet steady behind the tanker on its own.
outcome: The X-47B finished the refueling with no pilot aboard, completing the last test of the Navy's drone demonstration program.
title: Drone refuels itself in midair
description:
The Navy's X-47B became the first unmanned aircraft to complete autonomous aerial refueling, near Patuxent River, Maryland, on April 22, 2015.
